items: ½ cup vegetable or canola oil
⅔ cup mashed banana (about 2 small bananas)

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Heat oven to 375°F. Spray bottoms only of 12 regular-size muffin cups with cooking spray (or you can use liners).

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.body: In a medium bowl combine **⅔ cup granulated sugar**, **½ cup vegetable or canola oil**, **2 large eggs** and stir with wire whisk. Add in **⅔ cup mashed banana** and **1 tsp vanilla extract**, whisk until combined.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Add in **1⅔ cups all-purpose flour**, **1 tsp baking soda**, **½ tsp salt**, and **½ tsp ground cinnamon** and stir together until just combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Divide batter evenly among muffin cups and bake for 17 to 21 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and muffins are high and rounded on top. The tops of the muffins should not look wet and a toothpick inserted into the center should come out with crumbs on it, NOT wet batter.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Remove muffins from the pan to a cooling rack.

steps.title: Add the topping
steps.body: Combine **¼ cup granulated sugar** and **½ tsp ground cinnamon** for the topping in a small bowl, put **3 Tbsp butter**, melted, in a separate small bowl. Dip muffin tops into melted butter and then into cinnamon-sugar. Serve warm or let cool completely.
